task_context.problem_statement: Alvin is 30 years old and Simon is 5 years away from being 1/2 the age of Alvin.  How old is Simon?
task_context.reference_solution:

Simon is 5 years away from being half the age of Alvin so Simon is 15-5 = <<5+5=10>>10 years old
